title: Random Player Size
description: Randomizes every player's height for more variation
body:
## Random Player Size
Adds more variation to players by randomizing their height.

## What does this do?
Upon joining a world with this datapack, your size will vary from 0.85 to 1.15 times the normal height. Except with the use of commands, you are stuck with this height forever.

## How to use
Enter **/function rps:config**

You can now change the minimum and maximum size a player can have. You can also re-roll somebody's size by typing in their name.
<details>
<summary>Installation</summary>
  
### Server Installation (Datapack)
  
1. Go in the main server file
  
2. Open _world_ -> _datapacks_

3. Upload the datapack in the _datapacks_ folder

### World Installation (Datapack)

1. Press Win + R and enter %appdata%

2. Open _.minecraft_ -> _saves_ -> _<world name>_ -> datapacks

3. Upload the datapack in the _datapacks_ folder

(Note that if you are using a launcher like Modrinth App or Prism Launcher, you'll need to go on your instance on the launcher and click on _Open Folder_.)

### Server Installation (Mod)

1. Go in the main server file

2. Open _mods_

3. Upload the mod in the _mods_ folder
</details>
